title: Task 1.1: Recommending Attractions, Transport, and a History Museum to a Visiting Friend
content:
You have received an email from an international friend, David, who is planning to visit your city for three days. Read part of his email below:

"I am so excited about my upcoming trip to your city next month! Since it is my first time visiting, could you suggest some must-see attractions? What is the most convenient public transport to get around the city, and is there an interesting history museum you would recommend for me to explore local culture?"

Write an informal email responding to David.

body.answer: You should visit the central walking street and the famous local night market during your three-day stay.
body.example: For example, on Saturday evening we can walk around the pedestrian square, try authentic Pho, and take nice photos by the river.
body.frame: I am genuinely thrilled to hear that you are planning to visit my hometown! There are two suggestions that I would like to make.
body.reason: They give you the opportunity to increase knowledge and broaden your horizons about local culture, food, and daily life while letting us enjoy face-to-face interaction.
body.requirement: Suggest must-see attractions in your city for David's three-day visit

body.answer: From my point of view, I think that using the city bus or metro line is the most convenient public transport to get around.
body.example: For instance, you can buy a cheap 3-day transit card at the main station to travel directly between the city center and major sights.
body.frame: From my point of view, I think that ______. / Why don't you [V-bare] ______?
body.reason: Public transport is fast and convenient for busy people in modern-day society, and it fits comfortably within your budget without getting stuck in heavy traffic.
body.requirement: Recommend the most convenient public transport to get around the city

body.answer: I believe you should spend half a day at the City History Museum in the downtown area.
body.example: For example, the second floor displays ancient tools, old city maps, and traditional clothes with clear English descriptions.
body.frame: I believe you should ______. / I would like to let you know that ______.
body.reason: It provides knowledge and experience in local history and helps you gain a deeper understanding of people, culture, and tradition in Vietnam.
body.requirement: Recommend an interesting history museum to explore local culture

opening.fill: your upcoming three-day trip to my city

hint.purpose: Reply to David with recommendations for must-see attractions, convenient public transport, and an interesting history museum for his three-day trip.

title: Task 1.2: Informal Complaint Letter to a Friend About Bad Restaurant Service
content:
You recently had dinner at a new restaurant in town and had a terrible experience. Write an email to your close friend, Emily:

- Describe when and why you went to that restaurant.
- Complain about the poor customer service, long waiting time, and bad food quality.
- Explain why you will never return and warn her against dining there.

body.answer: Last Saturday evening, I went to the new grill restaurant near the mall to celebrate my cousin's birthday with our family.
body.example: Specifically, we booked a table for four at 7:00 PM because it looked modern and popular in online ads.
body.frame: I would like to explain what happened. / I would like to let you know that ______.
body.reason: We wanted to try a cozy place where we could reach a healthy balance between busy work and family time and enjoy a good meal together.
body.requirement: Describe when and why you went to that restaurant

body.answer: The first problem I encountered was the rude staff and a 50-minute wait before our food arrived, and worse still, the dishes were cold and way too salty.
body.example: For example, when I politely asked the waiter for warm soup and clean forks, he ignored our table for another twenty minutes.
body.frame: The first problem I have encountered is ______. / The issue here is ______. / Because of this, ______.
body.reason: The main reason for this is that the restaurant had too few waiters and the kitchen lacked proper organization, which ruined our mood instead of helping us relieve stress.
body.requirement: Complain about the poor customer service, long waiting time, and bad food quality

body.answer: From my point of view, I will never go back there, and I believe you should avoid dining at that place too.
body.example: Why don't you choose our favorite noodle shop on Le Loi Street next weekend instead so you don't waste your money and evening?
body.frame: From my point of view, I think that ______. / Why don't you [V-bare] ______?
body.reason: Going there wastes money on bad meals that look nothing like the advertised photos, so it is better to stay on the safe side and pick a trusted restaurant.
body.requirement: Explain why you will never return and warn her against dining there

opening.fill: the terrible dinner I had at a new restaurant in town

hint.purpose: Tell Emily about a terrible dinner experience at a new restaurant, complain about the service, wait time, and food, and warn her not to go there.

title: Task 2.2: Living in the Countryside versus Living in Big Cities
content:
Read the following statement:

"Some people prefer living in peaceful countryside areas with clean air and close communities, while others argue that living in large metropolises offers vastly superior career opportunities, modern amenities, and healthcare."

Discuss both views and give your own opinion.

body1.example: For instance, my grandparents moved back to their hometown village, and they feel much healthier and happier growing their own vegetables every morning.
body1.focus: View 1: Why people prefer the countryside (Preferred view)
body1.frame: Firstly, the first reason is that [ld1]... + Trục 1 (Physical health) & Trục 4 (Peace & Privacy)

body2.example: For example, my brother moved to Ho Chi Minh City after university because he could easily find a good office job and take evening English classes.
body2.focus: View 2: Why others prefer big cities
body2.point: On the other hand, big cities offer better job opportunities with higher pay, modern schools, and well-equipped hospitals. This helps young workers improve their living standard and get quick medical care when needed.

title: Task 2.3: Conflicts between Parents and Teenagers during Adolescence
content:
Read the following statement:

"During adolescence, conflicts frequently arise between parents and teenage children because parents often perceive their children as too young and immature, while teenagers desire more independence, personal space, and respect for their own viewpoints."

Write an essay to an educated reader analyzing the root causes of these conflicts and proposing practical solutions to bridge the generation gap between parents and teenagers. Support your arguments with specific reasons and illustrative examples.

body1.example: For instance, my cousin often argued with his parents because they wanted him to study medicine while he dreamed of becoming a graphic designer.
body1.frame: Firstly, the first reason is that [ld1]... + Câu #15 & Mini-essay #2 & Chunk #22
body1.point: Family conflicts often happen when busy parents force traditional views on teenagers instead of listening to their modern concerns with patience. Meanwhile, teenagers want more freedom and spend hours on smartphones, which widens the generation gap.

body2.example: For example, when my uncle started having a 30-minute coffee chat with his teenage son every Sunday, they understood each other much better and argued less.

body2.frame: Secondly, to deal with this problem... + Giải pháp A (Cá nhân & Gia đình) + Chunks #23, #24
body2.point: To solve this problem, parents and teenagers should talk openly with patience and respect each other's opinions. Families should also eat dinner together and share weekend activities to truly understand each other through face-to-face interaction.

hint.conclusion: In conclusion, parent-teenager conflicts mainly come from poor communication and different views, so both sides need to listen patiently and spend quality time together.

content:
You have received an email from your pen friend, Daniel. Read part of his email below:

body.answer: During this break, I usually travel with my family, read interesting novels, and take short skill courses.

body.frame: I would like to let you know that ______.

body.requirement: Describe what activities you typically do during this summer break

body.answer: Between the two options, I believe you should join a sports club this summer rather than only taking indoor music lessons.
body.example: Why don't you join a local badminton or swimming club three afternoons a week? You will stay active and quickly make new friends.
body.frame: I believe you should ______. / Why don't you [V-bare] ______?
body.reason: Playing sports is beneficial to your physical health because it helps you keep fit, strengthen your immune system, and meet like-minded people to enrich your social life.
body.requirement: Suggest whether Daniel should take music lessons or join a sports club

title: Task 2.4: The Benefits of Sharing Household Chores among Family Members
content:
Read the following statement:

"In contemporary society, many families still assume that domestic housework is primarily the responsibility of women. However, others believe that sharing household chores equally among all family members, including children, yields profound benefits for family harmony and personal growth."

Write an essay to an educated reader explaining the benefits of sharing domestic housework. Support your arguments with specific reasons and illustrative examples.

body1.example: For instance, my parents asked me to wash dishes and clean my room from age ten, which helped me live easily on my own during university.
body1.focus: Benefit 1: Teaching children independence and life skills
body1.frame: Firstly, the first reason is that [ld1]... + Câu #14 & Câu #6
body1.point: Sharing daily housework teaches children practical life skills like cooking, cleaning, and managing their time. When kids help at home early, they become more independent and know how to take care of themselves in the future.

body2.example: For example, in my home, my dad cooks dinner while my mom rests, and then we all talk happily while cleaning up together.
body2.focus: Benefit 2: Reducing mothers' burden and building family harmony
body2.frame: Secondly, it allows that [ld2]... + Câu #14 & Chunks #9, #10, #23
body2.point: Dividing chores equally prevents mothers from carrying the entire family burden alone after a long workday. As a result, everyone can relieve stress, reach a healthy balance between work and family time, and feel closer together.

hint.conclusion: In conclusion, I wholeheartedly agree that sharing housework brings huge benefits because it helps children learn essential life skills and builds a happier, less stressful family.

intro.ld1: teach children useful life skills and responsibility
intro.ld2: reduce stress for mothers and bring the family closer

title: Task 1.5: Advising an International Friend on Public Transport and Airport Commute in Hanoi
content:
You have received an email from an international friend, Mark, who will attend a two-month academic exchange course in Hanoi. Read part of his email below:

"I am arriving at Noi Bai Airport next Monday for my two-month study course in Hanoi! Could you give me some information about public transportation in Hanoi? Which transport mode would you recommend for daily commuting, and should I take a public bus or book a taxi from the airport to your place?"

Write an informal email responding to Mark.

body.answer: Hanoi has a wide public bus network, two modern elevated metro lines, and many affordable motorbike taxis and ride-hailing cars.
body.example: For example, bus number 86 runs directly between the airport and the city center, while regular city buses cost only 7,000 to 10,000 VND per ride.
body.frame: I am genuinely thrilled to hear that you are planning to visit! / I would like to give you information on ______.
body.reason: Public transport fits comfortably within a student budget and helps you adjust and adapt to the local environment quickly without buying your own vehicle.
body.requirement: Give Mark information about public transportation in Hanoi

body.answer: For daily commuting to your classes, I think that taking the metro or the public bus is your best option.
body.example: For instance, if your campus is near Cat Linh or Cau Giay, taking the metro takes only 15 minutes and avoids morning traffic jams.
body.frame: From my point of view, I think that ______. / I believe you should ______.
body.reason: It is fast and convenient for busy people in modern-day society, keeps you out of hot weather and rain, and lets you stay on the safe side in heavy traffic.
body.requirement: Recommend a transport mode for daily commuting during his two-month course

body.answer: Because you will have heavy luggage after a long flight, I believe you should book a taxi or ride-hailing car from Noi Bai Airport to my place.
body.example: Why don't you message me your flight number before Monday? I can help you book a trusted car straight from Terminal 2 to my house.
body.frame: There are two suggestions that I would like to make. / Why don't you [V-bare] ______?
body.reason: Taking a door-to-door taxi is much more comfortable and helps you reduce fatigue after flying instead of carrying big suitcases onto a crowded bus.
body.requirement: Advise whether to take a public bus or book a taxi from the airport to your place

opening.fill: public transport in Hanoi and getting from Noi Bai Airport

hint.purpose: Give Mark information about Hanoi's public transport, recommend a daily commuting mode, and advise him on taking a bus or taxi from Noi Bai Airport.

title: Task 2.5: Reasons for the Surging Popularity of Online Shopping
content:
Read the following statement:

"In recent years, e-commerce platforms and online shopping have experienced exponential growth, fundamentally transforming the shopping habits of consumers worldwide."

Write an essay to an educated reader explaining why online shopping has become so remarkably popular. Provide specific reasons and illustrative examples from your own personal experience to support your arguments.

body1.example: For instance, I was very busy preparing for my exams last month, so I bought all my new notebooks and snacks on a shopping app in five minutes.
body1.frame: Firstly, the first reason is that [ld1]... + Chunks #18, #21
body1.point: Online shopping is fast and convenient for busy people in modern-day society because they can order anything from home in just a few minutes. They do not need to waste time sitting in heavy traffic or waiting in long lines at crowded stores.

body2.example: For example, my friend often buys cheap clothes during online flash sales, though she ends up returning half of them because of poor quality.
body2.focus: Reason 2 & Impact: Discounts, variety, and shopping risks
body2.point: E-commerce apps also attract buyers with big discounts, free shipping, and thousands of products to compare easily. However, this convenience sometimes tempts buyers to waste money on cheap items that look nothing like the advertised photos.

hint.conclusion: In conclusion, online shopping has become extremely popular because it saves time and offers great deals, though customers should still think things through calmly before clicking buy.
